description: Integrated V5 central counterfactual combining data-supported heating and cooling service envelopes, paid V1G smart charging, endogenous paid V2G contracting, and derated firm-flexibility capacity credit. Base remains unchanged.

parameter_status.thermal_service: The accepted Power_curve_V2 BAIT +/-1 C envelope is scaled by explicit 25% heating and 20% cooling enrolment. Non-negative continuous service inventories remain periodic over the selected horizon.
parameter_status.ev_v1g: Fifteen percent of the immutable EV charging baseline is schedulable in the central case. Only downward displacement of the uncontrolled reference is charged as relocated V1G energy; incremental charging used to replenish V2G discharge is not misclassified as V1G relocation.
parameter_status.ev_v2g: V2G is an endogenous incremental contract nested inside smart charging. It pays separate annual availability, bidirectional-infrastructure, owner-compensation and battery-degradation costs and is subject to a national contracted-power cap.
parameter_status.capacity_value: Only derated, peak-deliverable service receives firm capacity credit. The coefficients are transparent engineering assumptions, not a China-specific ELCC estimate.
parameter_status.price_basis: All monetary parameters are expressed in 2025 constant CNY. Retail energy tariffs and incentive transfers are excluded from social system cost; real control, infrastructure, inconvenience and degradation costs are included.
parameter_status.legacy_scalar_alignment: The inherited generic shift-throughput and degradation scalars are aligned to the V5 central V1G relocation and V2G degradation values for manifest readability; the optimization uses the service-specific cost input file.
